m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I had a feeling you'd wind up joining me. Honestly, charging off like that was just a bluff. Alone, I'd be trampled, so I'm glad you came.
Kobra Kommander and I go way back - I'm talking eggs in the same nest, before he became a control freak and started giving orders.
I'm not too good at following orders. You may have noticed that, so he eventually tossed me in Tetrus Prison. Now, it's time for payback.
Strato-Vipers - at attention! We have an intruder in the den. Our mortal enemy - Snake Eyes. Neutralize him or suffer Kobra Kommander's Wrath!
So I guess you're wondering why he called me Snake Eyes. That's what they called me in the Serpentine Special Forces Unit - the Jee Eye Joaz.
When Kobra Kommander seized power, we stood against him. That's when I lost the eye and the name. Can't really go by "Snake Eyes" with only one.
I've gone by Plizkin ever since. Suits me better these days, but it doesn't mean I forgot. No, and it's time to remind Kobra too.
Snake. I would say I'm pleased to see you, but we both know that's not the case. I actually heard you were dead.
Yeah. I heard that too. Also heard you were Kobra's right-hand man these days. Funny - I always had you pegged as the guy calling the shots.
You never know. Perhaps I'm playing the long game. Perhaps. It's a shame you won't be here to find out. Time for me to make the rumors true!
Good riddance. That silver-scaled Boa was the one who first corrupted my nest-mate. Not that there's any chance for redemption, mind you.
Nah, I figure it's either Snake or Kobra at this point, and you can probably guess who gets my vote. C'mon. Let's get this over with.
Look here! If it isn't my old nest-mate and nemesis! Things have been dull around here without you! It's been too long, Plizkin!
Call me Snake. And trust me - I know how long it's been. I was counting the hours, rotting away in Tetrus Prison, dreaming of this moment.
You always were an idealist. That's what made you weak! You're a relic. There's no room for Serpentines like you in Modern Serpentine Society.
Stop this blathering and let's get on with it! Ready to lose your other eye? Oh, don't worry! I won't stop there!
All right. Let off the poor wretch. I think he's had enough. You know, Kobra, you and I used to be pals, until you went and betrayed me.
Haven't had too many friends since then, but I think I've found a new one today in this Wizard - and this one's really got my back.
Stop gloating and just level with me... are you going to kill me, Snake?
Not now. I'm too tired. Maybe later. We are going to take that Chronoshard though, and then we're going to leave the city - in peace, I hope.
You'll never leave the city. You won't get past the Serpentine Gate. And then I'll see you thrown back in Tetrus Prison - where you belong!
We'll see about that. C'mon, Wizard. Let's get your Chronoshard and get out of here.
<ITALICS>The Aridian Chronoshard is warm and hums quietly as you stow it in your pack. Now, you and Snake Plizkin can escape from Istanboa. </ITALICS>
You got the Chronoshard? Nice. I know it's not all that valuable, but it belongs with House Calixco.
So here's the deal. To get rid of me, my sweet father - the Baron - cut a deal with the Serpentines, with Kobra Kommander himself, in fact.
As payment for getting me out of the way, the Baron handed over our House Chronoshard. We can't leave Istanboa without it.
Out of the question. Unquestionably. We've risked too much already and charging into the Vipers Den would be pure madness...
Speak for yourself, Mongu. I've got a score to settle with Kobra Kommander. Just needed an excuse. Cower here if you like, but I'm going in.
Well, Wizard? I got the impression you really did the heavy lifting in the Prison. He'll get clobbered without you, won't he? You better go.
Well, Wizard? You better go.
